_doc: Our own props in this zone (OwnProps.cs; the presets: tools/assets/env_props.json, built by env_props.py). pieces: a kit piece of props.json -> the preset standing in for it wherever it stands (fitted to the kit piece's height, on its footprint). keep: [x, z] places where the kit piece stays (another lead's). place: a preset stood at x, z (on the ground, + y), turned rot radians about up, scaled; or along a line from a to b ([x, y, z], the preset's long axis on it) at radius r (a log). bare: [r, k] the grass gone within r and thinning out to k times r (with the fires, the first four in the zone). hide: [x, z, r, max height] the web game's blocked-out meshes there go (not its kit pieces). lamps: a lamp holder's light by its glow node: color, energy (times the road lamps'), range, att, day (its share when not night), spec (its specular; E8: the gate torches' pools on the cobbles, smooth and dim at dawn). nudge: [x, z, dx, dz, degrees] the preset standing in for the kit piece at x, z shifted and turned (the chest off the log's end). drop: landmark nodes that go (the unlit standing lantern west of the camp, a crate in its place). kits (E7b): a KayKit piece of landmarks.glb (kk-PACK-NAME-N) -> our preset standing in for it (a list: the copies take them in turn by N), built in the kit piece's own units and frame so it stands where the kit piece stood, inside its collider; {"preset", "over": the made piece (Pieces.cs) stays under it, minus what the preset is (the crypt keeps its slate roof, coping and iron door), "scale"}; "flora:NAME" is one of our own trees. flora_move (E7b r3): [x, z, dx, dz] shifts the zone's flora copy at x, z (within 0.5 m), [x, z] drops it (nine trees north-east of the Watch-post, on the dawn sun's line to its walls' tops (out to 30 m: the sun is 18 degrees up), moved 4-10 m aside, so the wood keeps its density; lf1b: the first five, a spruce clump on her line south from the camp at z 63-70 (Experience 3: trunks ~1 m from her path), moved 3 m west, the one that would stand on (-11.7, 69.9) dropped; E8: the spruce at (6.05, -14.93) and the broadleaf at (6.14, -19.97) about 2 m east, off C01 s8a's line to the third ford lamp). lit_light: the "lit" torches' own light (color, energy times the kit torch's, range, att). The barrow's crosses and the headstone at (-17, 0) are nudged (turned) so their faces meet the play camera (their kit frames had them edge-on). H4 item 10 r2: the day stretch's Kerchief camp (44, -89) and boars' wallow (-42, -89) and their tracks off the road opened by flora_move (the copies moved out to the clearings' and tracks' edges, so the wood keeps its density); flora_move now moves the tree's collider too (ZoneMeta.MoveFloraColliders).

place._doc: Env 22 r1e (judge: the wood road by night one violet value, nothing at its verges): the wood road's verge kit at the moonlit gap (flora_move: three alders from deep in the wood to the road's west edge, their shadows across it north and south of the gap)

C01 set (judge: a stock crate and a treasure chest the brightest props in s10 and s12): a traveller's camp, so her saddlebags where the crate stood and her pack where the chest stood (the camp's chest is a kit piece of dressing, cleared: "clear"; the watch's chest by the post, the tutorial's, stays)
Env 22 r1c (triage judge: the gate's apron large, flat and empty): a handcart left by the west tower, barrels and a crate by the east one, off the way
Env 22 r2 (judge r1: the apron still empty): loose cobbles, straw off the carts, twigs (gate_apron, camp_ground's kit; no shadow); the puddle is "puddles"
H4 item 10 r2: the Kerchiefs' camp in a clearing 44 m east of the road (flora_move opens it and its track; the strongbox at its back, by the crates)
H4 item 10 r2: the boars' wallow in the low hollow 42 m west of the road (flora_move opens it): a fallen spruce across its north side
